answer: Charge identity creation with evidence that cannot be resold: every new address must anchor to an existing cluster by posting a self-signed bond that is slashed together with the whole cluster if any member is later caught as one of many coordinated clones. The attacker's cheap opal looks precious only until it must be locked at N times face value across N linked seats, all forfeited on a single detection, so a farm stakes far more capital than it can ever withdraw. Honest agents spread the same total over unrelated clusters, giving the ledger a basalt foundation of independent anchors.
